Kaisa.build: Build armor first against Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, so also build magic resistance and health if you can’t quickly stop an enemy who dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct.
Kaisa.combo: Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge just after a basic attack hits, then activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire before the next attack. Keep attacking the same target to build stacks, then detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump. A max-stack explosion resets Tristana W Rocket Jump’s cooldown, so you can jump back out.
Kaisa.escape: If Kai'Sa E Supercharge’s movement speed boost is down too, that’s a good window to build bomb stacks, but first work out whether Tristana W Rocket Jump can reset.
Kaisa.fight: Look to close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump when Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down or unavailable. If you apply Tristana E Explosive Charge, keep attacking the same target to reach max stacks. Don’t jump in if you can’t create a condition to reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Kaisa.laning: However, Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive pushes the lane on its own, so deliberately choose whether to get vision and pressure or keep the wave near your side. Don’t stand alone away from the minion wave when you expect Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Kaisa.phase: Tristana’s burst is limited through the mid game, so focus on safe farming and turret pressure instead of reckless engages. In the late game, use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s range advantage and high damage to fight from afar.
Kaisa.teamfight: Use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s range advantage to attack from the back line, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump to escape. If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock her back and stop the engage. Place Control Wards in side bushes and entry paths before a fight to prepare for Kai'Sa E Supercharge’s stealth.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, you may become the target of Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. Stand near allied minions to spread the damage when Kai'Sa uses Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If Kai'Sa P Second Skin has stacked on you, the danger increases as health gets lower, so wait out the stacks from outside her range.

Ashe.fight: Trade when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has expired. Ashe has no mobility, so close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump instead of walking in while slowed. Before jumping in, work out whether a takedown or max stacks of Tristana E Explosive Charge can reset W.
Ashe.escape: Engage when Ashe W Volley and Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow are down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has expired. Ashe has no mobility, but crowd control can interrupt Tristana W Rocket Jump, so don’t jump in recklessly while Ashe R is available.
Ashe.combo: Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge when you can stay on Ashe long enough to build stacks. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before a basic attack, then keep attacking the same target to stack the bomb before detonating the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If the explosion gets a takedown or detonates at max stacks to reset W, jump back out.
Ashe.laning: In the early game, play safely and farm with Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive. If a low-health minion is near Ashe, use the area damage on its death to poke her. E pushes the lane, so deliberately choose whether to pressure with vision or keep the wave near your side. Don’t start pressuring the turret while W is on cooldown.
Ashe.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm while dodging Ashe’s poke. Her burst is still unreliable into the mid game before she gets attack damage items, so look for fights when Ashe W Volley is down. In the late game, use the extra range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from the back line.
Ashe.teamfight: Use the range advantage from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from the back line, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump to escape. Watch for Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, and use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock back enemies who dive your team. Jump in only when a takedown and W reset are certain, then continue to the next target.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is an area slow used to poke, so dodge to the side of its cone and look to trade right after it has been used. Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow is refreshed with every basic attack, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns and can interrupt Tristana W Rocket Jump midair, so don’t start a small fight from out of vision while her ultimate is available.

Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit several of you, and use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s range advantage to attack from the back line. Save Tristana W Rocket Jump to escape, but consider engaging if Aphelios doesn’t have Severum and a takedown is certain. Use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock back divers or interrupt dangerous casts.
Aphelios.combo: When Aphelios can’t escape immediately, apply Tristana E Explosive Charge just after a basic attack hits, then activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire before the next attack. Keep attacking the same target to reach max stacks. If you didn’t use Tristana W Rocket Jump to engage, detonate the final stack with the jump. If the max-stack explosion or a takedown resets the jump, jump back out.
Aphelios.escape: Engage when Aphelios isn’t holding Severum and has difficulty applying Gravitum’s slow and root. Tristana W Rocket Jump can be interrupted by crowd control midair, so don’t jump expecting to ignore the root. If you don’t expect the jump to reset from max stacks of E Explosive Charge or a takedown, save it to disengage.
Aphelios.build: Build armor first against Aphelios’s main damage. If the duel goes long, consider anti-heal after armor.
Aphelios.fight: Watch Aphelios’s current and next weapons, and trade when his immediate damage is low. Before engaging, work out whether max stacks of Tristana E Explosive Charge or a takedown can reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Aphelios.laning: Early on, farm and preserve your health with Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive. Since it pushes the lane, deliberately choose whether to get vision and pressure the turret or keep the wave near your side. If Aphelios is out of lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Aphelios.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm safely. Avoid reckless all-ins through the mid game before you have attack damage items, and pick fights when Aphelios has a weak weapon. In the late game, use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s increased range and high damage to attack from afar.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with Gravitum, get out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. If you’re marked by Calibrum, back off to avoid the follow-up attack. Spread out from allies when Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil is available.

Draven.laning: Farm safely early and don’t give Draven a chance to get a kill. Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive can push the lane, so get vision when pressuring and check that Tristana W Rocket Jump is available. If a safe trade is difficult, let Draven step forward to create an opening for your jungler.
Draven.phase: Early on, Draven’s axe attacks are strong while Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so play it safe. Her burst remains unreliable through the mid game before her build is complete, so avoid giving Draven kills and look for an opportunity. In the late game, use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s increased range and the high damage of a completed build.
Draven.build: Build armor first against Draven’s mainly physical damage. Also keep enough total health to stay above Draven R Whirling Death’s execute threshold.
Draven.combo: When the fight starts, apply Tristana E Explosive Charge and activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before a basic attack to build stacks. If you use E just after an attack hits, use the attack animation reset to follow with another attack. Jump in only when the final stack can be detonated with Tristana W Rocket Jump to create a reset opportunity.
Draven.escape: Draven has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has one or fewer Draven Q Spinning Axes. Before engaging, work out whether a max-stack bomb explosion or takedown can reset W. If a reset is unlikely, save W to escape.
Draven.fight: Don’t fight Draven while he has two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Fight when he has one or fewer, or when he can’t reach where an axe will land. Tristana R Buster Shot can reduce his damage by knocking him away from the landing spot.
Draven.teamfight: Use the extra range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from the back line, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump to escape. When Draven goes to catch an axe, Tristana R Buster Shot can knock him away and make him drop it. Use W to jump in and get a reset only when the enemy formation has broken up and a takedown is certain.
Draven.watch: Avoid early trades while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Draven E Stand Aside can interrupt Tristana W Rocket Jump midair, so don’t jump in before E is down. Draven R Whirling Death returns, so after dodging it once, move out of its path on the way back too.

Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, Caitlyn P Headshot can deal heavy damage while you’re rooted, so check bushes and narrow paths for traps and change your approach. Tristana W Rocket Jump can’t safely clear a trap, so check the landing spot too. Stand behind allied minions to reduce damage from Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker poke.
Caitlyn.build: Prioritize tenacity and movement speed so you don’t keep taking hits while rooted. If you build resistances, prioritize armor against Caitlyn’s main physical damage, such as Caitlyn P Headshot and Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker.
Caitlyn.combo: Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge just after a basic attack hits, then activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire before your next attack to stack it quickly. Work out whether Tristana W Rocket Jump can detonate the final stack and reset.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid paths with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap. Before engaging, check whether max stacks of E Explosive Charge or a takedown can reset W Rocket Jump so you can get out. If a reset is unlikely, save W Rocket Jump to escape.
Caitlyn.fight: Look to fight right after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave. After applying Tristana E Explosive Charge, continue the fight only if you can build it to max stacks.
Caitlyn.laning: Early on, don’t force trades into Caitlyn’s strong laning; farm under your turret and play it safe. Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive can push the lane, so don’t mindlessly push without vision. If Caitlyn is out of lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push the wave and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn’s laning is strong and Tristana’s damage is low early, so farm safely. Tristana’s burst is still unreliable in the mid game before she has attack damage items, so pick a window when Caitlyn’s abilities are down. In the late game, use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s increased range and high damage to attack from the back line.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s range to attack from the back line, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump to escape. Use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock back enemies who dive your team. Jump in to continue to the next target only when a takedown will definitely reset W and you can avoid the traps.

Ezreal.build: Early on, focus on getting Tristana’s attack damage items first. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so don’t lean on just one resistance if you need defense. Also consider choices that reduce attack speed or help close the gap.
Ezreal.combo: After Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, land a basic attack and use Tristana E Explosive Charge to reset the attack animation. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before the next attack and keep attacking the same target to stack the bomb. Detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump to reset W so you can jump back out.
Ezreal.escape: Use the moment after Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down as your window to engage. Apply brief pressure first to make him use E. When you follow with Tristana W Rocket Jump, work out whether you can reset W by detonating the bomb at max stacks or getting a takedown. Keep dodging Ezreal Q Mystic Shot during the engage, since repeated hits can bring E back sooner.
Ezreal.fight: Trade briefly while dodging Ezreal Q Mystic Shot with minions between you. Make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift first, then close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If you apply Tristana E Explosive Charge, continue the fight only if you can build it to max stacks before an escape.
Ezreal.laning: Early on, play it safe and farm with Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive. Since it can easily push the lane, deliberately choose whether to get vision and pressure the turret or keep the wave near your side. If Ezreal is out of lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, pressure the turret with Q Rapid Fire and E Explosive Charge.
Ezreal.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm safely. Her burst is unreliable into the mid game before she gets attack damage items, so fight when Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down. In the late game, use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s increased range to attack from afar.
Ezreal.teamfight: Don’t trade poke with Ezreal from afar; secure vision and an angle to close the gap. By default, use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s range to attack from the back line and save W Rocket Jump to escape. Jump in only when Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down and a takedown is certain. Use Tristana R Buster Shot when you need to knock someone back.
Ezreal.watch: Block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot by standing behind minions, and avoid getting hit repeatedly to keep Ezreal E Arcane Shift’s cooldown from being reduced. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move out of range before taking the follow-up attack.

Jhin.build: There is no specific purchase order for Tristana in the guide. Prioritize armor against Jhin’s main damage, but armor won’t block the magic damage from Jhin E Captive Audience.
Jhin.combo: If Jhin is reloading and you’ve dodged Jhin W Deadly Flourish’s root, apply Tristana E Explosive Charge just after a basic attack hits to reset the attack animation. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire before your next attack and keep hitting the same target to build stacks. Detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump to reset, then jump out if needed.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so the opportunity to engage with Tristana W Rocket Jump comes when you dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish and he starts reloading. Jumping onto a Jhin E Captive Audience trap will trigger it, and crowd control can interrupt you midair, so check your jump path. Save W to escape if a reset is uncertain.
Jhin.fight: Count Jhin’s shots and engage while he’s reloading or after he has fired one or two shots. Don’t engage if his fourth shot is ready. After dodging Jhin W Deadly Flourish, you can close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump, but first work out whether a max-stack bomb explosion or takedown can reset W.
Jhin.laning: Early on, farm and play it safe with Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive. Since it can push the lane on its own, get vision and keep Tristana W Rocket Jump available when pushing to pressure the turret. Keep away from low-health minions to avoid Jhin Q Dancing Grenade.
Jhin.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm safely. Her burst is unreliable through the mid game before she gets attack damage items, but she has strong damage with a completed build in the late game. Use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s increased range to fight without jumping in.
Jhin.teamfight: Use your range to land basic attacks from the back line while your frontline first takes Jhin W Deadly Flourish, the shots from Jhin R Curtain Call, and Jhin E Captive Audience traps. Save Tristana W Rocket Jump to escape, and engage only when a takedown can reset it. Use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock back enemies approaching your team or interrupt dangerous casts.
Jhin.watch: Jhin’s fourth shot deals heavy damage, so back off while it’s ready. Jhin Q Dancing Grenade gains damage each time it kills a target as it bounces, so stay away from low-health minions. Immediately after being hit by Jhin’s basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, move out of the narrow line of Jhin W Deadly Flourish. When low on health, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call.

Jinx.build: Build armor first against Jinx’s main damage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Jinx E Flame Chompers!, so dodge the traps themselves.
Jinx.combo: Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before a basic attack, then use Tristana E Explosive Charge just after the attack hits to follow with another. Build stacks on the bomb with basic attacks, then detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If the max-stack explosion or a takedown resets Tristana W Rocket Jump, jump back out.
Jinx.escape: Jinx has no ability to create distance, so look to engage after she has used or missed Jinx E Flame Chompers! and missed Jinx W Zap!’s slow. Close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump, but calculate whether a max-stack bomb explosion or takedown can reset the jump before going in.
Jinx.fight: If Jinx is poking with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets, look to trade when she has no minigun attack speed stacks. If you apply Tristana E Explosive Charge, fight only when you can keep hitting the same target to reach max stacks.
Jinx.laning: Early on, use Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive to farm safely, and don’t stand beside a minion that will be hit by Jinx’s rocket attack. E pushes the lane, so deliberately choose whether to get vision and pressure the turret or keep the wave near your side. If Jinx is out of lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push and pressure the turret.
Jinx.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm safely. Her burst is still unreliable into the mid game before she gets attack damage items, but she deals high damage with a completed build in the late game. Use Tristana P Draw a Bead’s increased range, and don’t start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.teamfight: Use the increased range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from the back line, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump to escape. Jump in only when a takedown is certain and Jinx has either used Jinx E Flame Chompers! or missed Jinx W Zap!. Use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock back enemies approaching your team or interrupt dangerous casts.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets also damage nearby targets, so don’t stand next to a minion when she farms with a rocket. Jinx E Flame Chompers! can trigger where Tristana W Rocket Jump passes, so don’t jump through the traps. If health has decreased, don’t stay within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!, which gets stronger based on missing health.

Kalista.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Kalista W Sentinel, which scales with your maximum health, so be careful about relying on health stacking alone.
Kalista.combo: Right after a basic attack hits, apply Tristana E Explosive Charge to reset the attack animation, and activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire before your next basic attack. Keep attacking the same target to build stacks, then detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If the maximum-stack explosion or a takedown resets Tristana W Rocket Jump, jump out immediately.
Kalista.escape: When Kalista R Fate's Call is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump. Kalista P Martial Poise requires her to start a basic attack, so after engaging, knock her outside attack range with Tristana R Buster Shot. Engage when the slow from Kalista E Rend is gone and you can meet a Tristana W Rocket Jump reset condition.
Kalista.fight: Kalista P Martial Poise relies on basic attacks, so forcing her out of range also prevents her hops. Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge before Kalista builds up spears, and fight when you can fully stack the bomb with basic attacks. Before going in with Tristana W Rocket Jump, first calculate whether maximum bomb stacks or a takedown can reset its cooldown.
Kalista.laning: In the early game, farm with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive, but harass Kalista by splashing its area damage near her when you kill minions. This effect pushes the lane on its own, so don't push carelessly without vision. If several of Kalista's spears have lodged in you, retreat while breaking vision behind a wall or in a brush. When Kalista is away from lane, pressure the turret while Tristana W Rocket Jump is available.
Kalista.phase: Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage early, so farm safely. Her burst remains limited through the mid game, before she gets attack damage items, so only choose fights where you can fully stack Tristana E Explosive Charge. Late, use the range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from behind and take advantage of your damage advantage in a longer game.
Kalista.teamfight: Use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range advantage to basic attack from behind, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. If Kalista R Fate's Call looks ready to throw her support, spread out, and knock away an approaching enemy with Tristana R Buster Shot. Jump in only when the enemy formation breaks and a takedown will definitely reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Kalista.watch: Kalista E Rend cashes in all the spears stuck in you at once, so if several spears have lodged in you, stop fighting and back away until they disappear. Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend deal physical damage, while Kalista W Sentinel deals magic damage based on your maximum health. Before Kalista R Fate's Call, spread out if her bound support moves close to her, and knock away the thrown enemy with Tristana R Buster Shot if they approach.

KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first against Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Also consider armor to reduce his basic attack damage. Since each basic attack during Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals additional damage based on your maximum health, avoid relying on health stacking alone.
KogMaw.combo: After Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down, close in with Tristana W Rocket Jump. Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge, activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire, and use basic attacks to reach maximum stacks. If the bomb detonates at maximum stacks and resets Tristana W Rocket Jump, jump out again.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility, so the window to engage is after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down. Even if you go in with Tristana W Rocket Jump, delay the engage if you cannot meet a reset condition, since you will have no way out. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the true-damage explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.fight: Start trading after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires. If Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump, but before going in, calculate whether you can reset the jump through maximum stacks on Tristana E Explosive Charge or a takedown.
KogMaw.laning: In the early game, farm safely with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive. It pushes the lane on its own, so when pressuring, establish vision and prepare for the enemy jungler. If Kog'Maw is away from lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push the wave and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
KogMaw.phase: Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage early, so farm safely. In the mid game, disrupt Kog'Maw's farming and pressure turrets and objectives to create a chance to end quickly. Both champions deal high damage late, so use the range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to keep your distance.
KogMaw.teamfight: Attack from behind, using the range from Tristana P Draw a Bead, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. Target Kog'Maw after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires, but only jump in when a takedown will definitely reset it. Use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock away an enemy who gets close, and after killing Kog'Maw, leave the blast radius of Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, its range and maximum-health-based damage increase, so keep your distance until it expires. Block Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle with minions or sidestep it; if it hits you, avoid fighting while your armor and magic resistance are reduced. Watch for the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, and when low on health, leave vision to avoid the range and bonus damage of Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.

Lucian.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian R The Culling. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Lucian W Ardent Blaze. The provided information does not specify a particular item to buy first.
Lucian.combo: After Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, approach with Tristana W Rocket Jump and start a fight when you can apply Tristana E Explosive Charge and fully stack it. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before a basic attack; if you use Tristana E Explosive Charge right after a basic attack hits, you can reset the attack animation and immediately follow with another attack. Build stacks with basic attacks, then detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump to reset W.
Lucian.escape: Only look to engage with Tristana W Rocket Jump right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is used. Before going in, calculate whether you can detonate Tristana E Explosive Charge at maximum stacks or get a takedown to reset W. If a reset is unlikely, save W for escape, and knock Lucian away with Tristana R Buster Shot when you're in danger.
Lucian.fight: After weathering Lucian's first burst combo, keep fighting once his abilities are down. Right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is used, you have a chance to close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Lucian.laning: In the early game, farm with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive, and splash its area damage onto Lucian by killing low-health minions near him. This effect makes the lane easy to push, so plan for turret pressure and vision together. If Lucian is away from lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push the wave and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Lucian.phase: Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage early, so dodge Lucian's first combo and farm safely. Her burst remains limited through the mid game, before she gets attack damage items, so pick a short window to fight after Lucian's abilities and mobility are down. Late, use the range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from afar and play the longer game to your advantage.
Lucian.teamfight: Use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range advantage to basic attack from behind, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. Sidestep when you're in the path of Lucian R The Culling. Knock away an enemy who dives onto an ally with Tristana R Buster Shot, and jump in only when the enemy formation breaks and a takedown will definitely reset W.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and can reach farther than its indicator shows, so when Lucian targets a minion, step out of the line behind it. When Lucian R The Culling starts, sidestep instead of running straight backward. Avoid trading if Lucian receives a shield or healing, or an ally becomes immobilized, empowering his next two shots.

MissFortune.build: Build armor first against Miss Fortune's main physical damage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, and lowering her attack speed can also help reduce her basic attack damage.
MissFortune.combo: Start a fight by applying Tristana E Explosive Charge and building stacks with basic attacks. Using Tristana E Explosive Charge right after a basic attack hits can reset its attack animation, and activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before your next basic attack. Engage when you can detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump to reset its cooldown, then use the reset Tristana W Rocket Jump to escape.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility, so look for a chance to engage with Tristana W Rocket Jump after leaving the slow field from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. Before going in, calculate whether a maximum-stack Tristana E Explosive Charge explosion or a takedown can reset Tristana W Rocket Jump and let you escape. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with Tristana R Buster Shot or sidestep the cone.
MissFortune.fight: Avoid extended fights early, and back away right after Miss Fortune attacks a minion so you don't get hit by her empowered attack. Delay your engage while Miss Fortune E Make It Rain covers the area. Miss Fortune has no mobility, so engage when you can safely get close and meet a Tristana W Rocket Jump reset condition.
MissFortune.laning: Avoid standing in line with minions to dodge the bouncing attack from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Harass by killing nearby minions with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive, but keep in mind that it pushes the lane on its own. If Miss Fortune is away from lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push the wave and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
MissFortune.phase: Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage early, so farm safely. Her burst remains limited through the mid game, before she gets attack damage items, so avoid forcing an engage. Late, use the range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from behind and take advantage of your damage advantage in a longer game.
MissFortune.teamfight: Don't start a fight where Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is cast; move outside the area. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, you can interrupt it with Tristana R Buster Shot. Use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range advantage to basic attack from behind, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces through minions, so don't stand directly behind one. When Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is cast, don't fight in the slowed area; move out of it. Miss Fortune R Bullet Time fires in a fixed direction, so sidestep or interrupt the cast with Tristana R Buster Shot.

Nilah.build: Build armor first and add health against the main damage from Nilah Q Formless Blade, Nilah E Slipstream, and Nilah R Apotheosis. If Nilah's healing prolongs the duel or the enemy support has healing, buy Executioner's Calling earlier.
Nilah.combo: After Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, apply Tristana E Explosive Charge and build stacks with basic attacks. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before attacking, then detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump. Before engaging, first calculate whether the explosion can reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Nilah.escape: Engage with Tristana W Rocket Jump only when Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil are down and you can lock Nilah down. Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so don't jump in just because it was used. If Nilah approaches and puts you in danger, knock her away with Tristana R Buster Shot, then escape with Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Nilah.fight: Hit Nilah from outside her range, but back away farther right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends and you can prevent her from approaching with Nilah E Slipstream, apply Tristana E Explosive Charge and fully stack it. If Nilah gets close, knock her away with Tristana R Buster Shot and create distance with Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Nilah.laning: You can splash area damage by killing nearby minions with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive. Since this effect pushes the lane, decide deliberately whether to establish vision and pressure or let the lane push toward you.
Nilah.phase: Tristana's burst remains limited through the mid game, so focus on growing while denying her an angle to get close. Late, use the range from Tristana P Draw a Bead and your completed build's damage to fight from afar.
Nilah.teamfight: Spread out from allies to avoid several of you being caught by Nilah R Apotheosis, and use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range advantage to basic attack from behind. If Nilah engages and uses Nilah W Jubilant Veil, look for the moment your basic attacks work again; knock her off an ally with Tristana R Buster Shot if she gets close. Save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape, and only engage when a takedown will definitely reset it.
Nilah.watch: After Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range briefly increases and she hits in a cone, so step back farther. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, your basic attacks miss, so stop basic attacking and wait for the effect to end. Spread out so several allies aren't pulled in by Nilah R Apotheosis.

Samira.build: Build armor first, since Samira Q Flair, Samira W Blade Whirl, and Samira R Inferno Trigger deal physical damage. Lowering her attack speed can also help you take fewer hits from Samira.
Samira.combo: After Samira W Blade Whirl ends and your basic attack hits, apply Tristana E Explosive Charge, then activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire and build stacks with your following basic attacks. Detonate the bomb's final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump; if you get a takedown or maximum-stack explosion, escape with the reset jump. Using Tristana E Explosive Charge while a basic attack is in progress cancels the attack, so wait for it to hit first.
Samira.escape: Right after Samira E Wild Rush is down is your window to engage with Tristana W Rocket Jump. However, getting hit by an initiation ability near Samira can allow an engage, so dodge crowd control and go in when you can meet a jump reset condition. If you can't expect a reset, save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape.
Samira.fight: Use your range advantage to manage the distance Samira walks to reach you and trade with basic attacks. After Samira W Blade Whirl ends, apply Tristana E Explosive Charge and build stacks. Engage after Samira E Wild Rush is used when a takedown or maximum bomb stacks can reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Samira.laning: In the early game, farm with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive and avoid Samira's melee engage. Harass Samira by splashing area damage onto her when you kill minions, but keep in mind that it pushes the lane on its own. When pushing to pressure the turret, establish vision and check that Tristana W Rocket Jump is ready.
Samira.phase: Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage early, so farm safely. Her burst remains limited through the mid game, before she gets attack damage items, so fight at a distance that denies Samira an engage. Late, use the range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from behind.
Samira.teamfight: Attack from behind using your range advantage, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. If no one dies after Samira E Wild Rush takes her in, focus Samira then.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is active, it destroys basic attacks and projectiles, so attack after the spin ends. Don't stay close for long if Samira keeps attacking in melee range, since she can build her ultimate rank. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, knock her away with Tristana R Buster Shot to interrupt the fire.

Senna.build: Build armor first against Senna's main damage. Senna P Absolution deals damage based on your current health, so build armor too instead of stacking health alone.
Senna.combo: Right after a basic attack hits, use Tristana E Explosive Charge to reset the attack animation and follow with your next attack. After applying the bomb, build stacks with basic attacks, then activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire to quickly finish the remaining stacks. Detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump, and if it resets, jump out again.
Senna.escape: After dodging or once Senna W Last Embrace has been used, go in with Tristana W Rocket Jump when Senna can't create distance. Don't engage when Senna W Last Embrace could hit you, since it can interrupt your jump midair. First calculate whether you can reset the jump by detonating the bomb at maximum stacks or getting a takedown.
Senna.fight: Harass Senna when she steps forward to collect a soul and stop her from gathering mist. If you dodge Senna W Last Embrace and can fully stack the bomb, start a fight with Tristana E Explosive Charge. If it's hard to avoid a second attack after Senna hits you once, end the trade.
Senna.laning: In the early game, watch the locations of Senna's souls, and harass her with Tristana E Explosive Charge's area damage by killing low-health minions near her. Since Tristana E Explosive Charge can push the lane, deliberately plan turret pressure and vision together. If Senna is away from lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push the wave and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Senna.phase: Tristana has low damage and long cooldowns early, but if you leave Senna to collect souls, her range and attack damage keep growing. Early, stay in a safe position and pressure Senna when she steps forward to collect a soul. Tristana's burst remains limited through the mid game, so avoid forcing an engage; late, use the range from Tristana P Draw a Bead and your completed build's damage.
Senna.teamfight: Use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range to attack from behind, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, back away to a place with vision or block an engage angle with Tristana E Explosive Charge's area damage. Use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock away an approaching enemy, and jump in only when a takedown will definitely reset the jump.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions to harass and heal, so step out of the straight line formed by Senna and her target. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions; if it hits, move away from allies before the root spreads. After getting hit once, back away to avoid a second attack and stop Senna P Absolution from collecting mist.

Seraphine.build: Seraphine's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance if you need defenses. The provided information doesn't specify a particular item to buy first.
Seraphine.combo: If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, approach with Tristana W Rocket Jump. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before your basic attack, and apply Tristana E Explosive Charge right after the first attack hits, then build stacks with basic attacks. If the bomb detonates at maximum stacks and resets Tristana W Rocket Jump, jump out again.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility, so right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your chance to go in with Tristana W Rocket Jump. Before engaging, calculate whether maximum-stack Tristana E Explosive Charge or a takedown can reset Tristana W Rocket Jump. If a reset is unlikely, save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape.
Seraphine.fight: Look to trade when Seraphine is separated from your allied marksman. Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump and fight. If you apply Tristana E Explosive Charge, keep attacking the same target to fully stack it.
Seraphine.laning: In the early game, farm safely with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive. It pushes the lane on its own, so deliberately choose whether to establish vision and pressure the turret or let the lane push toward you. Even if Seraphine is away from lane, start pressuring the turret when Tristana W Rocket Jump is available.
Seraphine.phase: Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage early, so safe farming comes first. Her burst remains unreliable through the mid game, before she gets attack damage items, so choose a fight when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Late, use the range advantage from Tristana P Draw a Bead and your high damage to attack from afar.
Seraphine.teamfight: Use the increased range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to basic attack from behind, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. Since Seraphine R Encore can travel farther through allies, spread out from them laterally. Use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock away an enemy who approaches an ally or interrupt a dangerous cast.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you're slowed, move out of the line in front of Seraphine, and remember that crowd control can interrupt you even while Tristana W Rocket Jump is in the air. In teamfights, the charm from Seraphine R Encore reaches farther each time it passes through an allied champion, so don't stand in a line with allies.

Sivir.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. Her damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so consider options that reduce attack speed as well.
Sivir.combo: After Sivir E Spell Shield is down, land an auto attack, then immediately apply Tristana E Explosive Charge to use the attack animation reset. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire before your next auto and build bomb stacks. Go in when you can detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump and reset W.
Sivir.escape: The window to engage opens when Sivir E Spell Shield is down and you've dodged Sivir Q Boomerang Blade's path in both directions. Sivir has no blink-type mobility ability, so you can close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump. However, don't go in if you have no way to reset W afterward.
Sivir.fight: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield, then apply Tristana E Explosive Charge and fight only when you can fully stack it. If you dodge Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, that's your chance to trade with Sivir after she has spent mana. Before going in with Tristana W Rocket Jump, check whether a bomb detonation or takedown will reset it.
Sivir.laning: Early on, farm with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive, but keep in mind its splash damage makes the lane push on its own. Sivir clears waves quickly, so before leaving lane, push it first or make sure an ally is ready to catch the wave. If Sivir is away from lane, push while Tristana W Rocket Jump is available and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Sivir.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm safely. Her burst is lackluster through mid game before she gets attack damage items, so choose fights where Sivir E Spell Shield is down and you can fully stack your bomb. In late game, use the increased range from Tristana P Draw a Bead and your high damage to fight from afar.
Sivir.teamfight: Use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range advantage to auto attack from the back and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. Go in with W to look for a reset only when Sivir E Spell Shield is down and a takedown is certain. Use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock away enemies who dive your allies or interrupt a dangerous cast.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit both on the way out and on the way back, so if the first pass hits you, move out of its return path. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so check that it is down before using Tristana E Explosive Charge or Tristana R Buster Shot. Avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.

Smolder.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!. Resistance cannot block the true damage from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, which also deals damage based on your max health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Smolder.combo: Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge immediately after an auto attack lands to reset the attack animation. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire before your next auto, build bomb stacks, then detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If a takedown or a max-stack bomb detonation resets your jump, use it to get back out.
Smolder.escape: The moment after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down is your chance to engage. Dodge the slow from Smolder W Achooo!, then approach with Tristana W Rocket Jump and use Tristana R Buster Shot to stop Smolder from escaping again. Don't go in if you can't meet a reset condition for Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Smolder.fight: Bait out Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, then close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If you apply Tristana E Explosive Charge, fight only when you can fully stack it. Before going in, check whether Tristana W Rocket Jump will reset so you can get back out.
Smolder.laning: Smolder scales better than Tristana, so disrupt his kills with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath and his ability hits on champions from the start. Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive can damage Smolder when you kill low-health minions. Your lane may push on its own, so get vision when pressuring the turret and check that Tristana W Rocket Jump is ready.
Smolder.phase: Early on, Smolder has no stacks and his only escape is Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, but Tristana also has long early cooldowns and low damage. Farm safely while hindering Smolder's scaling, then take turrets and objectives quickly in mid game. Even though Tristana's late-game damage and range are strong, the matchup gets worse over time, so it's better not to let the game go long.
Smolder.teamfight: Use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range advantage to auto attack from the back and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. When Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands, avoid the center, and use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock away enemies who approach your allies. Jump in only when a takedown is certain to reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! explodes when it hits a champion and slows them, making follow-up attacks easier to land. Avoid it by standing behind minions or moving to the side. When Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands, move away from its high-damage center, then approach again after the flames at Smolder's feet disappear.

TwistedFate.build: Consider building magic resistance first against the damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, and Twisted Fate E Stacked Deck. Get movement speed too, so you can walk out of telegraphed areas.
TwistedFate.combo: Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before an auto attack, then press Tristana E Explosive Charge immediately after the auto lands to follow up with the next one. Build stacks on the applied bomb with auto attacks, then detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If a max-stack detonation resets W, use it to get back out.
TwistedFate.escape: Before going in, check whether a max-stack detonation from Tristana E Explosive Charge or a takedown will reset W.
TwistedFate.fight: The moment after Twisted Fate spends the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to close in. Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge at the start of the fight and keep attacking to fully stack it.
TwistedFate.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the damage you take from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive pushes the lane, so don't push carelessly without vision.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive and play safely. Her burst is lackluster through mid game, but she is strong in late game with a completed build, so a longer game favors you.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Use the range increase from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from the back and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. Consider going in after Twisted Fate spends his gold card, but only do so when a takedown can reset W. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny channeling within range, interrupt it with Tristana R Buster Shot.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate is holding a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one auto attack will stun you, so stay outside his auto attack range. Tristana W Rocket Jump can be interrupted by crowd control even while airborne, so don't rely on it to dodge the gold card.

Twitch.build: After getting through the early game safely, prioritize attack damage items to increase your damage. Twitch E Contaminate deals both types of damage, so building only one type of resistance blocks just part of it, and resistance can't reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom. If you invest in surviving, consider both your total health and ways to take fewer auto attacks.
Twitch.combo: Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge when Twitch is visible and you can keep attacking him. Press Tristana E Explosive Charge immediately after an auto attack lands to reset the attack animation, then activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before your next auto to build stacks. Detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump; if it resets the cooldown, use the jump to get back out.
Twitch.escape: Twitch has no dedicated escape ability, but Twitch Q Ambush grants movement speed, so look for an engage after he is revealed. Go in when Twitch W Venom Cask is down and a max-stack detonation from Tristana E Explosive Charge can reset Tristana W Rocket Jump. If the reset isn't certain, save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape and knock away Twitch if he approaches with Tristana R Buster Shot.
Twitch.fight: Don't keep trading inside Twitch W Venom Cask; get out with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If Twitch Q Ambush has ended, revealing his position, and Twitch W Venom Cask is also down, start a fight by taking advantage of Twitch's lack of an ability to create distance. Before going in, check whether a max-stack detonation from Tristana E Explosive Charge or a takedown will reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Twitch.laning: Early on, safely scale by killing minions with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive. Since it can easily push the lane, don't push without vision, and alert your allies if Twitch disappears with Twitch Q Ambush. If Twitch is confirmed away from lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push the lane and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Twitch.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm and play safely. Her burst is lackluster through mid game before she gets attack damage items, so avoid long fights where you're exposed to Twitch's auto attacks and Twitch E Contaminate. In late game, fight from the back using the increased range from Tristana P Draw a Bead.
Twitch.teamfight: When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread out to the sides instead of lining up with your allies, so you don't all get hit by the piercing auto attacks. Use Tristana P Draw a Bead's increased range to attack from the back and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. Once Twitch drops his camouflage and is revealed, coordinate with your allies on a target and use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock away enemies who approach.
Twitch.watch: If Twitch disappears with Twitch Q Ambush, check vision in bushes and narrow paths first and alert your allies. If Twitch W Venom Cask lands at your feet, escape with Tristana W Rocket Jump to reduce Deadly Venom stacks. If you've been hit by several auto attacks, create distance even if you appear to have health remaining, since Twitch E Contaminate can finish you off.

Varus.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. Varus W Blighted Quiver and Varus R Chain of Corruption deal magic damage, so armor alone can't block them, and be cautious about stacking health alone because of Varus W Blighted Quiver.
Varus.combo: If you can dodge Varus Q Piercing Arrow to the side and close the gap, apply Tristana E Explosive Charge immediately after an auto attack lands to reset the attack animation, then auto again right away. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before your next auto to build bomb stacks quickly. Detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump to reset it, then jump back out if needed.
Varus.escape: Varus has no ability to create distance, so go in with Tristana W Rocket Jump when Varus R Chain of Corruption is down and you've dodged Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Tristana W Rocket Jump can be interrupted by crowd control even while airborne, so don't jump in while ignoring Varus R Chain of Corruption. If a max-stack bomb detonation or a takedown can't reset Tristana W Rocket Jump, save it for escape.
Varus.fight: When Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, dodge to the side, then close the gap while Varus is slowed by the charge. If Varus's auto attacks have applied Blight stacks, don't keep fighting; back off until the stacks expire, then go in again. Before engaging with Tristana W Rocket Jump, first check whether a max-stack detonation from Tristana E Explosive Charge or a takedown can reset the jump.
Varus.laning: Early on, farm with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive, killing low-health minions near Varus to poke him with the splash damage. Its splash damage pushes the lane on its own, so deliberately choose whether to get vision and pressure the turret or pull the lane back. If Varus is away from lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push the lane and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Varus.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so focus on farming safely. Her burst is still lackluster through mid game before she has attack damage items, so decide whether to engage with Tristana W Rocket Jump only after checking the reset conditions. In late game, use the increased range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from the back and carry fights with your high late-game damage.
Varus.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Varus R Chain of Corruption doesn't spread to multiple people, and don't approach an ally who is bound. Avoid fighting for the few seconds after Varus gets stronger from a kill or assist, then fight again. Auto attack from the back using Tristana P Draw a Bead's range, save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape, and knock away enemies who approach your allies with Tristana R Buster Shot.
Varus.watch: If Varus W Blighted Quiver empowers an auto attack and applies Blight stacks, his following abilities deal damage based on your max health, so back off briefly to let the stacks expire. When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow aim, sidestep its path. Don't approach an ally bound by Varus R Chain of Corruption; stay far enough away that the tendrils can't reach you.

Vayne.build: Tristana has low early damage, so focus on getting attack damage items. If you need to build resistance, prioritize armor against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Armor doesn't reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, so don't rely on defensive items and keep taking hits.
Vayne.combo: Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge when Vayne Q Tumble is down and you can avoid the wall stun from Vayne E Condemn. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before an auto and keep hitting the same target to build stacks. If you press E immediately after an auto, confirm that it landed first so you can use the attack animation reset. Detonate the max-stack bomb with Tristana W Rocket Jump, then use the reset jump to get out.
Vayne.escape: Go in with Tristana W Rocket Jump immediately after Vayne Q Tumble, especially when Vayne E Condemn is also down. Before engaging, check whether a max-stack detonation from Tristana E Explosive Charge or a takedown will reset W. If the reset isn't certain, save W for escape and use Tristana R Buster Shot to peel Vayne if she approaches.
Vayne.fight: The moment after Vayne Q Tumble is your chance to close the gap. If you've applied Tristana E Explosive Charge, fight only when you can fully stack it with Tristana Q Rapid Fire.
Vayne.laning: Use Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive to kill minions and poke Vayne. Its splash damage pushes the lane on its own, so get vision when pressuring and check that Tristana W Rocket Jump is available. If Vayne is away from lane and W is ready, push the lane and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Vayne.phase: Both champions are weak early, but Tristana should pressure Vayne's farm and take away her time to scale. Tristana's burst is also lackluster through mid game before she gets attack damage items, so keep pressuring the lane and turret instead of forcing an engage. Tristana's late-game damage and range become strong, but Vayne also becomes hard to stop with defensive stats, so build an advantage around objectives and turrets in the early and mid game.
Vayne.teamfight: Avoid narrow passages and walls, and use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range advantage to attack from the back in open areas. Save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape, and knock away Vayne with Tristana R Buster Shot if she approaches.
Vayne.watch: Don't fight with your back to a wall, so you can avoid a wall stun from Vayne E Condemn. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals max-health-based true damage if she keeps hitting the same target, so count the hits and get out of range before it triggers.

Xayah.build: Build armor first since Xayah's main damage is physical. Her damage also relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so options that reduce attack speed can help reduce her damage.
Xayah.combo: Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge immediately after an auto attack lands to reset the attack animation, and activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire before your next auto. Keep attacking the same target to build stacks, then detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump. A max-stack bomb detonation resets Tristana W Rocket Jump, so use it to get back out.
Xayah.escape: After dodging the root path from Xayah E Bladecaller, close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump. Before going in, check whether a max-stack bomb detonation or a takedown will reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Xayah.fight: Keep trades short and reposition to avoid the returning feathers from Xayah E Bladecaller.
Xayah.laning: Early on, farm safely with Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive. Its splash damage pushes the lane on its own, so decide deliberately whether to get vision and pressure the turret or pull the lane back. If Xayah is away from lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push the lane and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Xayah.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm safely. Her burst is also lackluster through mid game before she gets attack damage items, so choose a fight when Xayah R Featherstorm is down. In late game, use the increased range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack from afar.
Xayah.teamfight: If Xayah R Featherstorm is still available, don't jump in first; confirm it is down before deciding to engage. In general, use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range to auto attack from the back and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. Use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock away enemies who dive your team or interrupt a dangerous cast.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you get hit by three or more returning feathers. If three or more feathers form a line between you and Xayah, move sideways immediately and don't fight in the same spot for long.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor doesn't apply to the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and reducing attack speed slows both Yasuo's auto attacks and the rate at which he can produce tornadoes.
Yasuo.combo: Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield first, then apply Tristana E Explosive Charge at the start of the fight. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before an auto, and you can press Tristana E Explosive Charge immediately after an auto lands to reset the attack animation. Use Tristana W Rocket Jump to detonate the final stack and look for a cooldown reset only when you can fully stack the bomb.
Yasuo.escape: Don't go in with Tristana W Rocket Jump just because one Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down. Engage with crowd control right after Yasuo casts his tornado, during the window before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again. Close the gap with Tristana W Rocket Jump and knock him away with Tristana R Buster Shot.
Yasuo.fight: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with light poke, then trade seriously. Look for the moment just after Yasuo casts his tornado, when Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks reset. While Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, reposition around the wall or save key abilities.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the minion wave thin on your side of the lane to limit the minions Yasuo can use with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive can push the lane on its own, so if you push, get vision and watch for an enemy jungle gank. If Yasuo is away from lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, push up and pressure the turret with Tristana Q Rapid Fire and Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, so farm safely using Tristana E Explosive Charge's passive. Her burst is still lackluster through mid game before she gets attack damage items, so choose a fight when Yasuo's tornado is down. In late game, use the increased range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to fight from a distance.
Yasuo.teamfight: Use Tristana P Draw a Bead's range advantage to auto attack from the back and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for escape. If Yasuo dives your allies, knock him away with Tristana R Buster Shot. Jump in only when the enemy formation has broken up and a takedown is certain to reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the gap, so watch for him to approach in areas with many minions. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, he can knock you up with a tornado, so watch for the sound and visual effect and sidestep. Crowd control can interrupt Tristana W Rocket Jump while you are airborne too, so don't jump through the tornado.

Zeri.build: The material does not specify a concrete item to buy first. If you build resistances, consider armor first to counter the physical damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on your maximum health, so think carefully before building a lot of health alone.
Zeri.combo: Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge after Zeri E Spark Surge is down, when you have time to build bomb stacks. Activate Tristana Q Rapid Fire just before your next basic attack, build stacks with basic attacks, then detonate the final stack with Tristana W Rocket Jump. You can escape with Tristana W Rocket Jump if it resets from a takedown or a maximum-stack detonation.
Zeri.escape: Look to engage just after Zeri E Spark Surge has been used, in open terrain after dodging Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Close the distance with Tristana W Rocket Jump and use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock Zeri back and prevent her escape. Tristana W Rocket Jump can be interrupted by crowd control even while airborne, so engage when you can meet its reset condition.
Zeri.fight: The moment after you make Zeri use Zeri E Spark Surge is your chance to close the distance. Use Tristana W Rocket Jump to approach, and fight when you can fully stack Tristana E Explosive Charge. Before engaging, work out whether a takedown or a maximum-stack bomb detonation can reset Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Zeri.laning: Zeri has short basic attack range and little kill pressure early, so use your range advantage to build a lead before her core items come online. Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive makes the lane easy to push, so choose deliberately whether to pressure the turret or pull the lane back. Don’t overextend if you can’t prepare for an enemy jungle gank or Tristana W Rocket Jump is on cooldown.
Zeri.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, but Zeri also has little kill pressure in lane and low armor. Farm safely early while using your range advantage to build a lead before Zeri’s core items come online. In the mid game, Tristana’s burst may still be unreliable, so avoid reckless engages. In the late game, make use of your increased range and high damage.
Zeri.teamfight: Use the extra range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to basic attack from the back, and save Tristana W Rocket Jump for disengaging. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t chase on foot; knock her back with Tristana R Buster Shot to create distance. Only go in with Tristana W Rocket Jump to look for a reset after Zeri E Spark Surge is down and a takedown is certain.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads over a wide area when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or face Zeri in a narrow passage. Zeri is faster with each hit while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, so don’t chase on foot. When your health is low, watch out for the execute from Zeri P Living Battery.

Ziggs.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of the marked areas for Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb. If you need defense, build magic resistance over armor. Tristana’s main damage is effective against Ziggs’s low magic resistance.
Ziggs.combo: When Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and a path without mines is open, close the distance with Tristana W Rocket Jump. Apply Tristana E Explosive Charge just after a basic attack hits, then activate Q Rapid Fire before your next basic attack to build stacks. If you can detonate the final stack with W Rocket Jump, escape with the reset W.
Ziggs.escape: Ziggs W Satchel Charge is his only mobility tool, so go in with Tristana W Rocket Jump immediately after it is spent. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield is on your approach path, don’t jump over it with W; find a path without mines or wait. Decide carefully whether to engage if you have no way to meet the reset condition for another Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Ziggs.fight: The moment after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave is your chance to close the distance. Use Tristana W Rocket Jump along a path without Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield to get in. Before engaging, work out whether you can detonate Tristana E Explosive Charge at maximum stacks to reset W.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, farm with Tristana E Explosive Charge’s passive, but keep in mind that its area damage will push the lane on its own. Pushing without vision leaves you vulnerable to an enemy jungle gank, so decide whether to pressure or pull the lane back. If Ziggs is not in lane and Tristana W Rocket Jump is available, pressure the turret with Q Rapid Fire and E Explosive Charge.
Ziggs.phase: Early on, Tristana has long cooldowns and low damage, making her weakest, so farm safely. Her burst remains unreliable through the mid game before you get attack damage items, so time fights around Ziggs W Satchel Charge being down. In the late game, use the increased range from Tristana P Draw a Bead to attack steadily from a distance.
Ziggs.teamfight: Use the range advantage from Tristana P Draw a Bead to basic attack from the back, and save W Rocket Jump for disengaging. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, look for an opportunity to engage, but check the minefield and the paths beyond walls first. Don’t group together where several players can be hit by Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, and use Tristana R Buster Shot to knock back opponents who approach.
Ziggs.watch: If you step on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, its slow makes it easy to get hit by follow-up abilities, so go around it or wait for it to disappear. Tristana W Rocket Jump is a dash, so it isn’t safe to cross a path covered in mines. When the area of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the blast center even if you can’t get completely out of range.
